title: Open Seminar; Literary and Critical Theory
description: Introduces graduate students to key cornerstone texts that have shaped significant areas of theoretical inquiry, focusing on language, the specificity of the written text, and representation. We will openly explore what it means to read critically. Additionally, we will reflect on our roles as readers, stepping outside hegemonic frameworks and disciplinary modes that frame and "negotiate" meaning and sensibility within academia. We will engage with contemporary texts central to ongoing critical debates.
